summary: Backend-only testing of new Bibbia (Bible reader — Riveduta 1927 Luzzi) endpoints. All 6 requested endpoint groups verified via pytest: /api/bible/translations, /api/bible/books, /api/bible/chapter, /api/bible/resolve, /api/bible/search, and authenticated /api/me/bible/state (GET+PUT). 12/12 tests PASSED. Verified: 39 AT + 27 NT books, Giovanni 3:16 contains 'Iddio ha tanto amato il mondo' with chapters_count=21, resolve of 'Giovanni 3:16' → book_nr 43, Salmi → 19, unknown book/chapter → 404, search 'pescatori' returns >=5 results including Marco/Matteo, regex-special query '(a+)+' returns 200 (no 500 / no hang), unauthenticated state calls → 401, and PUT→GET persistence for admin user works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4292 lines — should be split into focused modules (bible.py, auth.py, admin.py, donations.py, etc.). Not blocking, but past the >700-line guideline.
bible_search fallback swallows the original exception silently with a bare `except Exception:` — recommend logging the underlying error for diagnostics.

bible_resolve returns 400 'Riferimento non valido' only when both `book` and `reference` are missing; malformed `reference` (unparseable regex) silently produces the same 400 — acceptable but could be more explicit.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing admin user (pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / AdminTestPwd1!) and seeded Bible collections (bible_translations, bible_books, bible_verses) already present via startup bible_seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bible endpoints live at /api/bible/* (translations, books, chapter, resolve, search) and /api/me/bible/state. Default translation code is 'riveduta_1927'. Text index on bible_verses is language='italian'. Login endpoint is rate-limited 10/60s — reuse the session fixture. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_bible.py is fully passing.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All requested behaviors match spec.
